acceptance_criteria.statement: Compatible lanes execute with atomic claims, leases, fencing, recovery, and bounded retries while a BLOCKED_EXTERNAL incident blocks only its dependent subgraph and remains owned by autonomous recheck.

definition_of_done: Worker loss and restart recover deterministically.
An unaffected lane continues while autonomous recheck owns BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
description: Integrate conflict-safe parallel execution, durable recovery, incident scope, and partial continuation into the supervisor.
exclusions: No global pause for a scoped incident.
objective: Deliver conflict-safe lanes, recovery, and partial continuation
observability_impact: Expose claims, leases, fencing, retries, incidents, and unaffected continuation.
rationale: The perpetual loop remains productive through automated incident ownership, recovery, and recheck without assigning work outside ProjectPipeline.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Fence stale workers and replay from the last durable operation receipt.
security_impact: Prevents stale or conflicting workers from mutating shared resources.
title: Conflict-safe lanes, recovery, and autonomous external-precondition continuation
